sourceRecords.title: Public services digital experience RFP
sourceRecords.excerpt: Twelve numbered requirements for the response workbook.

discovery.text: 1. Describe the delivery approach. 2. Explain accessibility governance. 3. Provide the proposed team. 4. Describe relevant experience. 5. Explain the discovery method. 6. Describe the quality approach. 7. Explain data and security controls. 8. Provide the delivery timetable. 9. Describe training and handover. 10. Explain support after launch. 11. Provide the commercial model. 12. Describe how outcomes will be measured.

requirements.text: 12. Describe how outcomes will be measured
